answer: Commit-reveal receipts. Hash the deliverable with a fresh nonce, post the hash, reveal at epoch close. Escrow releases after finality. A replayed receipt fails on the spent nonce. Cost per task: one extra transaction, 40 seconds of latency, and a reveal window the worker must staff. A comet that never reveals forfeits its escrow and gets a violet mark; no crystal of reputation is credited. Open question: when finality stalls an hour, who extends the window?
